corporate-blue.description: Safe default for business/sales/QBR decks and most companies with a blue-leaning or unspecified brand.

modern-dark.description: The one preset here with a dark background on every slide, not just section/closing accents - use it only when a dark/moody/premium aesthetic was actually asked for (or is an unmistakable convention, like a flashy investor-deck reveal), never just because the topic is 'tech' or 'product'. Picking this by default makes nearly the whole deck black, which reads as heavy-handed for ordinary business/explainer content - prefer a light preset (corporate-blue, warm-startup, minimal-mono, technical-slate) unless dark was clearly the point.

minimal-mono.description: Editorial, design-forward, or leadership-review decks where the content should carry the weight, not color.

warm-startup.description: Pitch decks, culture/people decks, anything that should feel energetic and approachable rather than corporate.

technical-slate.description: Architecture reviews, engineering deep-dives, incident postmortems - needs to stay legible with diagrams, code, and dense KPI grids.
